sentences.en: Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
sentences.zh: 奇数乘以偶数是偶数，奇数乘以奇数也是奇数。

sentences.en: Having failed many times, he never gave up the plan.
sentences.zh: 多次失败后，他从未放弃这个计划。

sentences.en: Having visited Rome many times, he knows about it well.
sentences.zh: 多次访问过罗马后，他对那里的情况很了解。
